label: Singapore River
copy: The plan places the Singapore River at the centre of commercial and civic life. It is the geographic anchor for this proposed town.
evidence: The National Archives description lists the Singapore River among the mapped features.

label: Planned districts
copy: The plan labels places such as Chinese Kampong, Chuliah Kampong, Bugis Kampong and European Town. These are proposed divisions, not a complete record of the city as built.
evidence: The National Archives description identifies these named settlements and land divisions.

label: Plan versus city
copy: A plan can reveal an ambition as much as a place. The National Archives states that this proposed plan was not actually executed as shown.
evidence: National Archives accession SP002981, scope and content note.
